thakar-aki.l: Left ventricular ejection fraction under 35 percent. 1 point. Preoperative.
Preoperative intra-aortic balloon pump. 2 points. Preoperative.
Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. 1 point. Preoperative.

Type of cardiac surgery. NOT ordered by invasiveness: "other" scores the same as CABG plus valve, and isolated CABG scores 0 [cabg = Coronary artery bypass grafting only, 0 points; valve = Valve only, 1 points; cabg-valve = CABG plus valve, 2 points; other = Other cardiac surgery, 2 points]

Preoperative serum creatinine. A STEPPED term, never interpolated: Under 1.2 mg/dL = 0 points; 1.2 to under 2.1 mg/dL = 2 points; 2.1 mg/dL or above = 5 points. The 2 to 5 jump is larger than any single risk factor.

thwaites.l: Age 36 years or older? [yes = +2; no = 0] Older age pulls toward bacterial meningitis.
Blood white cell count 15,000 cells/uL or more? [yes = +4; no = 0] A high peripheral white count pulls toward bacterial meningitis.
Duration of illness 6 days or more? [yes = -5; no = 0] The only negative weight, and the largest. A longer history is the strongest single pull toward tuberculous meningitis.
CSF total white cell count 900 cells/uL or more? [yes = +3; no = 0] A high CSF cell count pulls toward bacterial meningitis.
CSF neutrophils 75 percent or more? [yes = +4; no = 0] A neutrophil-predominant CSF pulls toward bacterial meningitis.
